workshop_findings: Steady-state baseline: ~30 QPS for conversational agent during off-peak.
Peak open-market bursts: observed spikes up to 220 QPS during first 15 minutes of market open in test traces.
Average tokens per completion: 240 tokens (prompt+completion) with a long-tail up to 1,200 tokens for complex scenarios.
Observed token/sec requirement at peak (conservative): ~52k tokens/sec sustained for 15m bursts.
KV/prefix cache: ~58% hit rate — opportunistic savings for repeated prompts, but cannot rely for market-open spikes.
Latency targets requested: p95 <= 150ms for short-turn chat responses, p99 <= 400ms; legal pushing for p99 SLA language.
Throughput sensitivity: batching improves GPU utilization but may add 10–30ms to median latency; need config tradeoffs.
Traffic profile: 70% short queries (<100 tokens), 25% mid (100–500 tokens), 5% long (>500 tokens).
recommended_capacity: Baseline reserved: 8 x A100-80GB equivalent to cover steady-state with 10% headroom (30 QPS baseline).
Burst reserve/commit: allow autoscale burst to 20 x A100-equivalents for scheduled market-open windows (15–20 minute windows).
Recommendation to enable dynamic routing: route non-critical reranking/embeddings to cheaper private pool during bursts.
Batching policy: implement micro-batch timeout 6ms for chat hot path to balance p95 latency and throughput; tune per model.
KV cache policy: preserve prefix caching for common prompts; estimate 20–30% token cost reduction in steady-state.
Quantization: test int8 variants for reranking/embs to cut cost on non-chat workloads; keep FP16 for chat-critical models.
sla_negotiation_points: Uptime target: 99.95% for dedicated control plane; 99.9% application-facing SLA requested by ops.
Performance SLOs: define p95 and p99 latency tiers per route; propose weighted credits for SLA misses during scheduled maintenance.
Burst guarantees: commit to reserved burst capacity for scheduled market windows with advance notice and optional premium.
Credits and remedies: define credit formula tied to sustained p99 violations longer than 30 minutes.
Data residency & audit: include audit log retention and quarterly access reports for compliance.
Termination/procurement: include clause for early scaling after 6 months with rate-card for incremental GPUs.
